concept: Cost Explorer + Budgets: cost-driver analysis and threshold alerts
tests: Which tools show which services/accounts drive cost growth and alert when thresholds are exceeded.
expected: AWS Cost Explorer analyzes spending trends by service and account; AWS Budgets alerts when a threshold is exceeded. Triggers: "which services and accounts are driving cost", "alerts when spending exceeds thresholds", (Choose two).
why_not: CloudWatch Logs Insights queries logs; Config tracks resource configuration; neither analyzes cost.
